skitter.name: Skitter
skitter.description: Fast, low HP, arrives in swarms.

brute.name: Brute
brute.description: Slow and armored. Heavy Core damage.

glider.name: Glider
glider.description: Flies straight to the Core, ignoring the path.

saboteur.name: Saboteur
saboteur.description: Stops near towers and EMPs them for 3 s.

hive_overseer.name: Hive Overseer
hive_overseer.description: Boss. Shield phases; summons Skitters every 8 s.

mender.name: Mender
mender.description: Heals nearby aliens 6% max HP per second.

juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
juggernaut.description: Huge and armored. Can't be slowed, stunned or pushed.

cloaker.name: Cloaker
cloaker.description: Invisible to towers unless Vance or a Radar Relay is close.

burrower.name: Burrower
burrower.description: Tunnels under the path; can't be hit while underground.

spitter.name: Spitter
spitter.description: Stops to spit acid at towers in range.

hive_egg.name: Hive Egg
hive_egg.description: Laid by the Hive Queen. Hatches into Skitters.

siege_titan.name: Siege Titan
siege_titan.intro: It crushes towers as it walks
siege_titan.description: Boss. Stomps towers near the path.

hive_queen.name: Hive Queen
hive_queen.intro: Destroy her eggs before they hatch
hive_queen.description: Boss. Lays eggs that hatch into Skitters.

shield_drone.name: Shield Drone
shield_drone.description: Flies along the path; ground aliens under its bubble take half damage.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: Ignores the path and hunts Commander Vance.

mimic.name: Mimic
mimic.description: Disguised as an Energy Crystal near the path. Bites when Vance comes close.

carrier.name: Carrier
carrier.description: Big flyer that keeps dropping Gliders.

burrow_wyrm.name: Burrow Wyrm
burrow_wyrm.intro: It tunnels ahead and bursts out under your towers
burrow_wyrm.description: Boss. Tunnels forward along the path and erupts under towers.

adaptive.name: Adaptive
adaptive.description: Builds up to 60% resistance to whichever damage type hits it most.

thief.name: Thief
thief.description: Steals Energy at the Core and runs back to spawn. Kill it to get the Energy back.

leech.name: Leech
leech.description: Latches onto a tower and drains it until Vance knocks it off.

phaser.name: Phaser
phaser.description: Blinks a few tiles ahead along the path.

reflector.name: Reflector
reflector.description: Bullets and missiles bounce back at their tower. Beams, fire and splash get through.

swarm_mind.name: Swarm Mind
swarm_mind.description: Tougher for every alien around it, and hurries them along.

necro_spore.name: Necro-Spore
necro_spore.description: Raises aliens that just died nearby as weaker zombies.

infector.name: Infector
infector.description: Corrupts a tower so it shoots your towers until it's repaired.

blob.name: Blob
blob.description: Absorbs aliens it touches and grows.

bomber.name: Bomber
bomber.description: Flyer that bombs towers instead of heading for the Core.

jammer.name: Jammer
jammer.description: Vance can't shoot, repair or call Orbital Strikes near it.

artillery_grub.name: Artillery Grub
artillery_grub.description: Shells towers from outside their range.

pathcutter.name: Pathcutter
pathcutter.description: Digs a new shortcut through the terrain mid-wave.

swarm_queenlet.name: Swarm Queenlet
swarm_queenlet.description: Mini-boss. Her escort and every alien near her are faster and tougher.

mothership.name: Mothership
mothership.intro: It drops reinforcements as it takes damage
mothership.description: Boss. Floats across the map and drops waves of aliens.

hive_mind.name: Hive Mind
hive_mind.intro: Three bodies. Kill them close together or they revive
hive_mind.description: Boss. Three bodies share one bar; a body killed alone revives after 6 s.

fallen_commander.name: Fallen Commander
fallen_commander.intro: An infected Vance. She knows all your tricks
fallen_commander.description: Boss. Shoots towers, dodge-rolls when hurt and calls Orbital Strikes on tower clusters.

acid_leviathan.name: Acid Leviathan
acid_leviathan.intro: It surfaces from the acid and drags towers under
acid_leviathan.description: Boss. Swims under the path and drags the nearest tower under when it surfaces.

nest_heart.name: Nest Heart
nest_heart.intro: It won't come to you. Push out and destroy it
nest_heart.description: Boss. A stationary hive heart that births aliens until it's destroyed.

architect.name: Architect
architect.intro: It rebuilds the path as you hurt it
architect.description: Boss. At 66% and 33% HP it digs a new route and fills in the old one.
